job.prompt: Create a fast-paced endless 2D runner in a neon cyberpunk city. My character should automatically run forward while I jump over spikes, gaps, and laser obstacles. Make the course become gradually faster and more challenging. Track my distance, and let me instantly restart after crashing.

events.detail: Validated typed design; composing sections and registered mechanics
Checking jump trajectories, landing margins and objective consistency
Runtime specification and asset dependencies persisted
